description:
Presented maintained to an exceptional standard, this well presented four/five-bedroom detached family home offers bright, spacious accommodation in a peaceful low-density development just minutes from Mullingar town centre. Ready for immediate occupation, this home combines generous living space with quality finishes throughout, making it an ideal choice for growing families.

The accommodation comprises an entrance porch leading to a spacious entrance hall with under-stairs storage. The ground floor features a bright dual-aspect sitting room with a solid fuel stove, a separate living room, and a versatile office/playroom with fitted storage that could also serve as a fifth bedroom. The spacious kitchen is fitted with an excellent range of wall and floor units and is complemented by a solid fuel stove, while the adjoining utility room provides additional storage and direct access to the rear garden. A fully tiled ground floor shower room completes the accommodation on this level.
Upstairs, a bright landing leads to four generously proportioned bedrooms, three of which are spacious doubles. The principal bedroom benefits from a modern en-suite, while the remaining bedrooms are served by a well-appointed family bathroom featuring both a bath and separate shower.

Externally, the property enjoys a private, secluded rear garden, detached garden shed and gated side access. To the front, there is ample off-street parking.

Ideally positioned within walking distance of Mullingar town centre, the property enjoys immediate access to schools, shops, sporting facilities, restaurants and everyday amenities. The C-Link Road, N4 motorway and the Royal Canal Greenway are all close by, ideal for commuters and outdoor enthusiasts alike.

Offering spacious accommodation in a good location, this is a superb opportunity to acquire a turnkey family home in one of Mullingar's most convenient residential settings. Early viewing is highly recommended.
